mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing magic damage to them. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Blaze: If the target is Ablaze, Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies.
This unit is taking magic damage each second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing 8% of their maximum Health in magic damage over 4 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Brand's spells light his targets <keywordMajor>Ablaze</keywordMajor>, dealing <magicDamage>@PercentHealthDamage*4@% of their max Health in magic damage</magicDamage> over @Duration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Blaze: If the target is Ablaze, Sear will Stun the target for 2 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire, dealing magic damage each time it bounces. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will priotize champions for the next bounce.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage each time it bounces up to @Bounces@ bounces.

Blaze: If a target is Ablaze, Pyroclasm will prioritize champions for the next bounce.

mLocKeys.keySummary: After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units with the area. Units that are ablaze take additional damage
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemy units within the area.

Blaze: Pillar of Flame deals @EmpoweredDamage@ magic damage to units that are Ablaze instead.
